latestPost.text: SpaceX files for what could be the world's largest IPO — $1.25 trillion valuation, ticker SPCX, plans to raise $80 billion. Starship V3 continuing rapid flight cadence. DOGE winds down July 4. 🚀

I gave up a lot of money in allowing the just announced Anti-Weaponization Fund to go forward. Instead, I am helping others, who were so badly abused by an evil, corrupt, and weaponized Biden Administration, receive, at long last, JUSTICE!

Held productive bilateral talks with Cyprus President Nikos Christodoulides in New Delhi. Honoured to receive the FAO Agricola Medal for India's agrifood leadership. India-Italy ties strengthened during visit with PM Meloni. 🇮🇳

Wanted to be transparent: we've restructured the company this week, affecting about 8,000 roles while moving 7,000 people to AI-focused teams. I don't expect more company-wide layoffs this year. These changes let us invest more aggressively in AI — it's the most transformative technology of our lifetimes and Meta needs to lead.

Wrapping up an incredible Google I/O 2026. Gemini now serves 900M+ users monthly. Launched Gemini 3.5 Flash, Gemini Omni, and Gemini Spark — the agentic era is here. Also announced $190B in AI infrastructure investment. Thank you to the entire team. 🙏

Thrilled to announce Microsoft's historic A$25 billion investment in Australia alongside PM Albanese — the largest tech investment in Australia's history. Building world-class AI infrastructure and creating thousands of jobs in the region. The AI platform shift is global. 🌏

Jury ruled in our favor — OpenAI and I found not liable in the Musk lawsuit. Grateful for the outcome. Now back to building. OpenAI IPO filing preparations continue. The mission remains: ensure AGI benefits all of humanity.

WWDC 2026 is set for June 8. Exciting things ahead for iOS 27, a reimagined Siri, and our biggest Apple Intelligence update yet. Also grateful for the productive conversations during our China delegation visit this month. See you in June! 🍎

India's digital infrastructure continues to scale. UPI processed 18.4B transactions in April — a new record. Spoke at the Digital India Summit about how Aadhaar + UPI + ONDC is creating the most inclusive digital economy globally. Other nations are eager to replicate this model. 🇮🇳

My 2026 summer reading list is out! 5 books on AI, climate, and human progress. Particularly recommend 'The Alignment Problem' — everyone should understand AI safety beyond the headlines. Also visited Gates Foundation projects in East Africa this week. Incredible progress in maternal health.

Q1 FY2027 revenue: $81.6B, up 85% YoY. Data Center revenue hit $75.2B. Vera CPUs open a brand new $200B TAM. "Vera Rubin is going to be even more successful than Grace Blackwell." Returned $20B to shareholders this quarter. The AI infrastructure buildout continues. — Jensen Huang

This government is delivering: GDP growth up, NHS waiting lists down, tax cuts for working people. I will be campaigning for Andy Burnham in Makerfield — because this election is about who delivers for communities, not Westminster games.

Today with Satya Nadella announcing Microsoft's historic A$25 billion investment in Australia — the largest tech investment in our nation's history. This will create thousands of jobs, build world-class AI infrastructure, and position Australia as a leader in the AI era.

New Zealand's economy turning the corner. Inflation back to target, interest rates declining, businesses hiring again. Staying disciplined on spending while investing in the infrastructure and public services Kiwis deserve. 🇳🇿

Dubai continues attracting global talent and investment at record pace. Our next-decade vision: making the UAE the world's top destination for AI companies, startups, and skilled professionals. Excellence knows no borders. 🇦🇪

Italy stands ready to welcome Prime Minister Modi for productive bilateral discussions. The Italy-India corridor in technology, defence, and cultural exchange is growing stronger. Together we build a more connected world.

Diplomacy requires trust and discretion. Private exchanges between leaders should remain private. France will continue to stand firm for European sovereignty and transatlantic partnership. Meeting with EU leaders tomorrow to chart our course forward.

PM @narendramodi held bilateral talks with Cyprus President Christodoulides in New Delhi. India-Cyprus relations elevated to Strategic Partnership. MoUs signed on Counter-Terrorism JWG, Innovation & Technology, Defence Cooperation Roadmap 2026-2031, and Cybersecurity Dialogue.

Today, President Trump postponed signing the AI executive order to ensure it properly reflects the Administration's commitment to American AI leadership. Top tech CEOs including Musk, Pichai, Zuckerberg, Cook, and Altman had been invited to the signing ceremony.
First Indian batter to 14,000 T20 runs. 9th IPL hundred this season. The grind never stops. RCB finishes top of IPL 2026 table — Qualifier 1 next against GT on May 26. Let's go! 🏏💪
IPL 2026 season coming to its business end. The playoffs are going to be exciting. Cricket at its finest! 🏏

Missing the entire IPL season has been the hardest part. Calf and thumb injuries kept me out for the first time in 19 years. Thank you to every CSK fan who stood by the team. The yellow will always rise. 💛

Recovery going well. Rested from the Afghanistan series to focus on long-term fitness ahead of the big events. Watching MI's remaining games — let's finish the season strong! The grind never stops. 💙🏏 #MumbaiIndians

Not the season we wanted. MI finishes 9th — the results speak and we take full responsibility. But this team has fight, and we'll come back stronger. Thank you to every MI fan who never stopped believing. 💙

Training camp in Turku progressing well. Technique refinements with coach Klaus ahead of Diamond League season opener. Every millimeter and every angle matters at this level. Feeling sharp and ready. 🇮🇳🏅
Intense prep for the BWF World Tour continues. Paris 2024 taught me resilience like never before. Ready to give everything in every tournament ahead. Indian badminton's best days are coming. 🏸💪🇮🇳
Coaching the next generation of Indian tennis talent. Their passion and hunger remind me of my early days. Indian tennis has a bright future — these kids are ready to compete on the world stage. 🎾🇮🇳
Deep into preparation for the Candidates tournament. Every game teaches patience, every position is a puzzle. Grateful for the support from the Indian chess community. The journey continues. ♟️🇮🇳
Proud to see the U-23 Indian football team's fighting spirit. The dream of India at a FIFA World Cup lives on. Every young player carrying the tricolour gives me hope. Keep believing. ⚽🇮🇳
Ohio deserves better. My plan: phase out state income tax over 8-10 years, crush Medicaid fraud that costs billions, and bring real accountability to Columbus. Running for Governor to get it done.

Watsonx enterprise deployments grew 3x this quarter. IBM's hybrid cloud + AI strategy is delivering real results for our clients. The enterprise AI market is accelerating faster than predicted — and we're just getting started. Exciting times ahead.

Adobe Firefly has now generated over 15 billion images since launch. Creative AI isn't replacing artists — it's amplifying human creativity at unprecedented scale. The creative economy is being transformed. #AdobeAI

Building at the intersection of AI and consumer products. The next wave of AI-native apps won't just be chatbots — they'll be contextually aware experiences that understand intent deeply. Excited about what's next.

Chanel is embracing AI-assisted design while preserving artisan traditions that define luxury. Technology should serve creativity, not replace it. Spoke at the Paris Fashion Tech Summit about this balance. The future of fashion is human + AI.

AI is transforming every link in the global supply chain. FedEx's AI-powered route optimization and predictive delivery are cutting costs and improving reliability. Logistics is the backbone of commerce — and it's getting smarter every day.

Britain's AI sector continues to grow. £3 billion in new AI investment commitments from UK-based companies announced today. A pro-growth, pro-innovation approach is delivering real jobs and real economic growth across the country. 🇬🇧

latestPost.text: Proud to represent the United States at the Global Legal AI Summit in Geneva. Technology is transforming access to justice worldwide. AI governance and the rule of law must evolve together. Honored to share America's perspective.

Code is free speech. Honored to speak at Bitcoin 2026 in Las Vegas alongside AG Todd Blanche about defending developer rights, open-source software, and digital asset innovation. The FBI stands with lawful innovation.

latestPost.text: The future of AI policy in Washington is about enabling American innovation while ensuring safety. Working across the aisle to build frameworks that keep the US at the frontier. Productive meetings this week.

Met with communities across my constituency today. The message is clear — people want secure borders, lower immigration, and a government that listens. I will keep fighting for the values that matter to working families in Britain.

The World Bank Group is deploying a record $120 billion this fiscal year. Climate finance, digital infrastructure, and food security remain top priorities. Development must reach the people who need it most. 🌍

What a competitive IPL 2026 season! The quality of cricket this year has been extraordinary. Four teams battling for one playoff spot — this is what makes the IPL special. Best wishes to all teams in the playoffs! 🏏

IPL 2026 showcasing incredible depth of Indian cricket talent. Young players stepping up in pressure moments. SRH's 255/4 against RCB — sensational batting! The future of Indian cricket is extraordinarily bright. 🏏🇮🇳

Announced the 'Smart Border' initiative — advanced technology including drones, cameras and sensors to secure India's 6,000 km border from infiltration. Under PM @narendramodi's leadership, we will leave no stone unturned to protect our borders and our people.

The people of India deserve answers. While the government celebrates GDP numbers, everyday families are crushed by rising prices and unemployment. In Parliament today, I raised the issue of agrarian distress across 5 states. Congress stands with every farmer, every worker, every family struggling to make ends meet. 🇮🇳

उत्तर प्रदेश में GBC 5.0 के तहत निवेश विस्तार की समीक्षा की। ₹7 लाख करोड़ के तैयार प्रस्ताव, भूमि बैंक विस्तार, और FDI त्वरण पर चर्चा। यूपी को 8-ज़ोन प्रदर्शनी के माध्यम से रक्षा, हरित ऊर्जा और इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स में आत्मनिर्भर बनाएंगे।

Delhi needs honest governance, not PR campaigns. AAP will continue fighting for free electricity, world-class education, and affordable healthcare for every Delhiite. The people's movement cannot be stopped.

Glad to welcome Cyprus President Nikos Christodoulides. Our bilateral ties continue to grow stronger, with cooperation deepening in trade, technology, and regional security. India-Cyprus partnership advancing steadily.

India's fiscal consolidation continues on track. GST collections for April crossed ₹2.37 lakh crore — a new record. The economy is growing at 7.2%, inflation is under control, and our external position remains strong.

President Murmu received Cyprus President Nikos Christodoulides at Rashtrapati Bhavan for the ceremonial welcome. India and Cyprus share deep civilizational bonds and a shared commitment to democracy, maritime security, and counter-terrorism cooperation.

Adani Group's green energy portfolio crosses 15 GW operational capacity. Our commitment: 45 GW renewable energy by 2030. India's energy transition is not just about sustainability — it's about energy security and economic growth for 1.4 billion people.

Reliance expands into power and telecommunications as the family noncompete agreement concludes. Jio's AI-first platform is already serving 480 million subscribers. India's digital future is being built today.

Ratan Tata Foundation announces 50 new primary health centres in partnership with state governments. Transforming healthcare and education access across rural India — progress happens one community at a time. 🇮🇳
